{{Quote|I know Lando from the miners' cooperative&mdash;and, of course, I supply his asteroid refinery on Sarnus. I think he's at the refinery now. At least, that's where he wants you to meet him.''"<br />"''On Sarnus? How the blazes does he expect us to find it?|[[Omad Kaeg]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="C" />}}
'''Sarnus''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. In [[45 ABY]], Lando Calrissian had established a [[Sarnus Refinery|refinery]] on the world to mine the plentiful [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] present in the rift.<ref name="C" />

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] suffered an assassination attempt at Lando's refinery. Planned by [[Marvid Qreph|Marvid]] and [[Craitheus Qreph]], the attempt failed, but left more than 30,000 dead beings.
